company_info.company_description: "At Envirosmart Electrical, we set the benchmark in electrical and solar solutions ranging from consultation, to customised designs, electrical contracting and installation of both on and off grid solutions for commercial and residential projects.

reviews.review_description: I got quotes from installers recommended by Solar Quotes and got widely differing technical information, and quotes. I went through reviews on Solar Quotes and found Jeremy at Envirosmart, and after 5 minute phone call, I knew I was talking to someone with deep knowledge. His understanding of my needs, the technical information, the quote and the installation were great value, professional and efficient. We are very happy with our installation and his ongoing support!
Arrived on time, explained everything, panels tailored to conditions, good quality and price, no surprises

Had an existing 6kWh solar system on 3-phase home, wanted to add batteries with capabilities to add bi-directional EV charging later.I reached out to many installers. EnviroSmart was both informative AND offered a competitive price. It wasn't the absolute best price, but customer support was very responsive which was an important thing for us.Jeremy came around on time to see the current setup and check potential install locations. He asked what I wanted/needed and tailored the system accordingly. No pushy sales pitch, just and wrote down options/pricing on paper, explained pros/cons and left it to us to get back to him.We chose a system, paid deposit, penciled in an install date, requested some electricity bills and we waited for things to get done.Installation went well, there wasn't much to do other than sign some papers and pay remaining balance. Their team set things up exactly how we asked for (mix of AC/DC coupling), although it's tempting to deduct points for awful Jeremy's karaoke.
We were very satisifed with the quotation and installation process. We were provided with clear options and lots of helpful advice to assist with our final decision. Highly recommended.

Jeremy from EnviroSmart was a pleasure to work with. He was very knowledgeable, polite and a good communicator. Jeremy led a great team of workers who were professional and polite. I would recommend EnviroSmart Solar for their knowledge base, skill level, experience and customer service.

Second time I’ve used this local Sydney installer. Small business that offers good quality components and installation , good pricing, competent design and installation within a month of contract signing.Happy to discuss technical alternatives.(I’m an engineer working in utility solar, no other contact with the installer though).

I recently had Jeremy install a 8.9kW solar system on my house, and the customer service exceeded my expectations. Throughout the entire process, Jeremy maintained exceptional communication, providing detailed explanations of each step and the intricacies of solar system functionality. His punctuality was impressive, and even in the rare instance of a slight delay, Jeremy took a proactive approach by promptly reaching out to inform me.I couldn't be happier with the overall experience! Jeremy's dedication to ensuring a hassle free process and his commitment to excellent service truly set him apart.Thank you so much Jeremy and the EnviroSmart Team!
Jeremy went through and explained the quotes thoroughly and visited my house while other quotes were done over the phone or by e-mail. Installation went without a hitch. Started saving straight away.

Jeremy's quote was in the ballpark of four quotes that I received, three from Solar Quotes.  It was neither the most expensive nor the cheapest.However, what set Jeremy apart was the amount of knowledge he had about all of the products and how to maximise the value we obtain from it.  He was willing to share that information freely.  When everyone is supplying virtually the same products, being able to maximise return (or shorten the payback period) was a differentiator.  He has clearly used and played around with the equipment that he is selling and their interaction with the various energy companies, making it invaluable to draw on his experience and knowledge.His team of installers were efficient and got everything done on time and professionally.I am already seeing the benefits of installation after just 2 days, and we have not yet taken all the steps to maximise return.

Great at first to get the quote and installation.But not afterwards , been trying to contact or over 1 month now calling and messaging just for help, but now that he’s taken the money he’s reply is “ it’s not my problem” then hangs up.I’ve had bad experiences with tradies but this is definitely the worst experience I’ve had to date.Avoid at all costs!!

Jeremy was able to offer a competitive price for my 6.6kW system. Prompt with email replies. Installation went smoothly and was finished in half a day. Team cleaned up after themselves. Had a noise issue with the inverter unit afterwards and would have appreciated if they could have made an extra trip to investigate if it was installation or manufacturer issue. Other than that the system works well and reaches the max 5kW generation on most days.

Had a great experience with Jeremy from Envirosmart Solar. He was informative and helpful from the get go and went above and beyond to have us connected to power by our deadline. He designed an off grid system for us that meets all our needs. The installation process went smoothly and we are very happy with the result. Would highly recommend to anyone needing solar power or an off grid system. Thanks Jeremy!

We got 4 quotes but Jeremy was the only one who insisted that he come to our home and have a detailed look at our job.He arrived on time on a Saturday morning and spent well over an hour explaining all of the different options to us.We decided to go with a 13.2kw SystemWith Sungrow Inverter and Jinko type N panels.The installation went smoothly over 2 days.Jeremy also gave us an App which monitors our system’s performance in real time , so from my office I can see how many Kwh our system is feeding back into the grid.. at any given time.We were spending about $220 per month on Electricity, since the solar install that has fallen to only about $80 per month which is amazing.. And we are still in the middle of winter, we estimate that during the summer months we will generate and feed much more back into the grid.. We are feeding in about 45 Kwh per day at the moment on clear days..We are getting a 12 cent feed in tariff so we are feeding in about $5.40 with of electricity per day which gets credited off our bill.$5 x 30 Days = $150 discount off our monthly bill..We would thougherly recommend Jeremy Hall from Enviro Smart Electrical for any of your Solar needs.Next we are looking a battery to farm some solar and make some real $$Jeremy can also help us with this…
The entire process with Jeremy was smooth, communication and customer service was great. I thoroughly recommend EnviroSmart Solar

Other quoters seemed like salespeople whereas EnviroSmart had the actual installer come out and explain things and answer questions which felt genuine which is why we went ahead with them. Ended up adding a few more things like EV charger and new switchboard which added to the total cost but again we were happy to as we felt comfortable with Jeremy.
Jeremy was prompt with coming out to quote.  The Tesla battery was available and installed within a week . Jeremy made sure we had the app installed and showed us how to use it.
Jeremy and his team were extremely professional and I was very happy with their installation

Jeremy bent over backwards to accommodate our fast timeline and made sure that we felt well informed of our decisions. He was prompt and reliable and happily worked with our builders to get the installation done with minimal disruption to our site. Delighted with our new system and loving learning about how to make the best use of our appliances to maximise the benefit of our solar.

Jeremy and team did a fantastic job on  our install. What came through in every interaction was a very obvious pride in doing a great job and real passion for solar energy. We were really happy with the price and install process, honest communication and service throughout. Highly recommended!

Actual site visit to provide accurate quote.Always kept up to date.Very knowledgeable.Answered all of our questions and even provided some great advice on energy providers.Install went as planned.Would highly recommend Jeremy and the team.

Jeremy from Envirosmart is a local owner/installer.Pricing was good.He was knowledgeable about the product and delivered exactly was he said he would in the time frame that he set which was only 4 weeks from paying the deposit.Installation was a breezeHe has also been easy to get in touch with post install for any questions that I may have.

Jeremy was straight to the point and didn't beat around the bush when it came to recommendations. Had my best interests at heart and was very professional and informative. He also repaired a bunch of tiles on my roof and replaced my whirly bird which he definitely did not have to do. Always willing to help and stresses he is just a phone call away. Would recommended to anyone
Competent designer/installer with good pricing, good availability and responded to my requirements. Also local.

Every step of the way we have felt like we were in safe hands. It was reassuring to have Jeremy take care of every stage of the process personally. From the first phone call, to the site visit, to creating the proposal and the installation itself. He really listened to what we were hoping to achieve (fitting as many panels on our relatively small roof as possible) and answered my many, many questions patiently. Nothing was too much trouble and every little detail was taken care of. We're really happy with the system and could not have wished for a better experience or installer.System Size: 12.45 kWPanels: 30 X 415W Trina Solar Vertex S+Inverter: 2 × Fronius Primo 5.0-1 · 5000WMonitoring: The Monocle by Catch Power and Fronius Solar Web
Quoting was good with a site inspection, installation was positioned where required and then connected our phone to the WIFI direct to battery.

EnviroSmart Solar was able to answer all my questions and provide a detailed quote with lots of accessible and easy-to-understand explanations about different system options. Their quality of work and attention to detail was impressive. The customer service experience was very open and reassuring. After seeking advice and quotes from several companies I am glad I chose this company and would recommend them for their knowledge, ethical practices, and workmanship. The team from EnviroSmart Solar worked hard to communicate complex concepts and provide a competitive quote whilst not compromising on the integrity of the solar system.

The quotation was set out well on the phoe and easy to understand.The installation went very smoothly, for such a hard roof. The tradesmen were neat and tidy and what they said they would do they did correctly, no surprises.I can see now in real time how much power im drawing in and how much im useing.Thank you.

How was the sales/quoting process?The quoting process was smooth, Jeremy was communicative and provided me some initial options at 3 levels of price. After doing my own further research, I was able to provide my preferences to him and he was more than happy to accommodate me. He was happy to adjust my design all the way to install date at my request. He didn't lock me into using a particular panel or inverter brand but his recommendations matched up to my preferences. His price was fair for the amount of work and quality of components. The advice he gave during this process was accurate and matched up to my research online and for that I was happy to move ahead with Jeremy's quote.How did the installation go? Polite? Tidy? Punctual?Installation was smooth. Jeremy and the team were punctual and did not leave me waiting for them at the agreed start time. During the installation on the first day they had noticed a cracked panel upon delivery and was able to replace it immediately for the second day of install without casuing any delays. Jeremy and the team were polite and quiet, so we had no complaints from our neighbours. They worked efficiently and maximised the time they had on site. At the end of both days they cleaned up the rubbish and took it with them and left the area tidy. There suprisingly only a few cracked tiles at the end even though I prepared a lot more considering the size of the job so I was very happy about that.How was the customer service? e.g. did they help organise the grid connection after the install?Customer service was great. The handover was thorough. Jeremy went through the install, startup/shutdown process, safety measures and provided all documentation and checklists. Jeremy notified the grid of electrical works and I just had to notify our electricity company that we needed a solar meter replacement.Overall - very happy with Jeremy and the team.

Jeremy was a great communicator - I always knew what was going on. He and his team were on time, tidy and explained everything. He was upfront and honest about solar systems and what we needed (and didn’t need!).

Jeremy and team installed my solar power system. Jeremy’s expertise and recommendations is what puts him a class above everyone else. Their attention to detail and quality is A class. Thank you Jeremy and team for making our experience enjoyable and seamless.
Very fast and very professional. Jeremy and the team were on time and very thorough. They finished the job when they said they would. Would highly recommend him for solar installations.
